description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Pyke''' marks the target location with the shape of an ''X'' before striking it, [[File:Death from Below.png|20px|link=Kill#Execute|An icon representing the keyword Execute]] [[:Kill#Execute|executing]] enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] within the area that are below 250 – 550 (based on level) (+ 80% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 1.5 per 1 Lethality) [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] health. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt「 50% of the amount as physical damage. 」「 125 – 275 (based on level) (+ 40% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 0.75 per 1 Lethality) physical damage. 」
description.text: Active: Pyke marks the target location with the shape of an X before striking it, executing enemy champions within the area that are below 250 – 550 (based on level) (+ 80% bonus AD) (+ 1.5 per 1 Lethality)  health. Other enemies hit and enemy champions above the threshold are instead dealt「 50% of the amount as physical damage. 」「 125 – 275 (based on level) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 0.75 per 1 Lethality) physical damage. 」

description2.raw: If ''Death from Below'' hits an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] or at least one is [[death|killed]] inside the ''X'' by the ''execution'' or an ally, '''Pyke''' will [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] to the center of the ''X''. For the latter case '''Pyke''' can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.
description2.text: If Death from Below hits an enemy champion or at least one is killed inside the X by the execution or an ally, Pyke will blink to the center of the X. For the latter case Pyke can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost.

description3.raw: Each successful ''execution'' grants one ''[[File:Your Cut item.png|20xpx|border|link=Your Cut|An icon for the item Your Cut]] [[Your Cut]]'' to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural [[assist]] [[File:Gold colored icon.svg|20xpx|link=Gold|An icon representing Gold]] gold. Otherwise, '''Pyke''' is granted a ''[[File:Your Cut item.png|20xpx|border|link=Your Cut|An icon for the item Your Cut]] [[Your Cut]]'' for each enemy champion killed inside the ''X'' by an ally during ''Death from Below's'' cast time.
description3.text: Each successful execution grants one Your Cut to the last assisting ally, instead of its natural assist gold. Otherwise, Pyke is granted a Your Cut for each enemy champion killed inside the X by an ally during Death from Below's cast time.

notes.raw: * Applies [[File:Fear Beyond Death 2.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Raw damage]] [[:Damage|raw damage]] to executed targets and [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]] to targets above the threshold. * ''Death from Below's'' execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions. * ''Death from Below'' cannot execute [[File:Shaco Hallucinate 2.png|20px|link=Champion_summoned_units#decoys|An icon representing the keyword Clone]] [[:Champion_summoned_units#decoys|clones]]. They are always dealt 50% physical damage. * If the target is in a [[File:Zombie icon.png|20px|link=Death#Zombie_states|An icon representing the keyword Zombie state]] [[:Death#Zombie_states|zombie state]], does not enter the [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]] state, or is killed by the ability while ''above'' the execution threshold, ''Death from Below'' does not grant [[File:Your Cut item.png|20xpx|border|link=Your Cut|An icon for the item Your Cut]] [[Your Cut]] nor the recast. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] does not prevent '''Pyke''' from [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinking]]. * ''Death from Below'' cannot be [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]]; '''Pyke''' will always appear at the target location if enemy champions are caught inside the ''X'' even if he is moved (e.g. by being [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|displaced]]) during the cast time. ** The only exception is if he is being [[File:Suppression icon.png|20px|link=Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|An icon representing the keyword Suppression]] [[:Types of Crowd Control#Suppression|suppressed]], in which case he will not [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]]. * [[File:Axiom Arcanist rune.png|20xpx|link=Axiom Arcanist|An icon representing Axiom Arcanist]] [[Axiom Arcanist]] does not refund the cooldown while '''Pyke''' is able to recast.(unexpected) ** [[File:Axiom Arcanist rune.png|20xpx|link=Axiom Arcanist|An icon representing Axiom Arcanist]] [[Axiom Arcanist|Axiom Arcanist's]] tooltip counts it refunding ''Death from Below'' even when it doesn't.(bug) * ''Death from Below'' will not go on cooldown if '''Pyke''' dies during its cast. ** '''Pyke''' will still generate [[File:Your Cut item.png|20xpx|border|link=Your Cut|An icon for the item Your Cut]] [[Your Cut]] from enemies that die inside the ''X'' before '''Pyke''' dies.
notes.text:
Applies raw damage to executed targets and area damage to targets above the threshold.
Death from Below's execute against an enemy champion will aggro nearby enemy minions.
Death from Below cannot execute clones. They are always dealt 50% physical damage.
If the target is in a zombie state, does not enter the death state, or is killed by the ability while above the execution threshold, Death from Below does not grant Your Cut nor the recast.
Spell shield does not prevent Pyke from blinking.
Death from Below cannot be interrupted; Pyke will always appear at the target location if enemy champions are caught inside the X even if he is moved (e.g. by being displaced) during the cast time.
* The only exception is if he is being suppressed, in which case he will not blink.
Axiom Arcanist does not refund the cooldown while Pyke is able to recast.(unexpected)
* Axiom Arcanist's tooltip counts it refunding Death from Below even when it doesn't.(bug)
Death from Below will not go on cooldown if Pyke dies during its cast.
* Pyke will still generate Your Cut from enemies that die inside the X before Pyke dies.
